newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ population pegged at 3.696 million - SNZ.
newsitem.headline: NZ population pegged at 3.696 million - SNZ.

text.p: New Zealand's population at the end of 1996 was 3.696 million, provisional figures released Tuesday by Statistics New Zealand showed.

SNZ said the estimate, which included overseas visitors, was derived by adjusting the provisional population count of 3.660 million from the 1996 census of population and dwellings in March for natural increase and net external migration.
Natural increase is the excess of births over deaths and net external migration is the difference between arrivals to and departures from New Zealand.
The figure will be revised when the final population counts become available later this month.
